# NoviceMasculine

**Tags:** `appearance`

The masculine character-creation preset: a chibi body in the plain novice tunic. The player picks hair and hair colour on top of it (CharacterCreation); everything else is fixed.

> **Goal:** Give every new character the same readable chibi silhouette, told apart by hair and name

| `proportions` | json | yes | Body proportion multipliers (§8, chibi preset) |
